scene.speaker: sofia
scene.bubble: A traveller packs smart: one jacket, two jumpers, and boots for every adventure!
scene.intro: A traveller packs smart, says Sofía, and she folds one jacket, two jumpers and a pair of boots. Erik packs differently: he takes six shirts, no trousers and a machine that folds socks by itself — and does not work. In winter they wear scarves, in spring they wear light shirts. What do YOU wear when it is cold? Open your wardrobe and tell us!

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the clothes words.

words.clue: You wear it outside when it is cool.
A warm top for cold days.
Strong shoes for rain and mountains.
You wear it round your neck.
Some girls wear this instead of trousers.
A hat for sunny days, often with a team name.

activities.title: Match the clothes with the body part.
Listen. What is everyone wearing today? Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Sofia: Look at the Club today, Erik! … Sofia: Valentina is wearing her purple jumper and a grey skirt. … Sofia: Mateo has got his green jacket — and two different socks, as always! … Erik: Ha! And you? … Sofia: My new boots! Brown, for walking in the hills. … Sofia: You are wearing your orange cap backwards again. … Erik: It helps me think! … Sofia: And Luna is wearing her red winter scarf. The most elegant dog in town!
